metadata.title: Lagrangian Foliations on compact Kähler manifolds
metadata.abstract: We prove that a compact Kähler manifold carrying a regular Riemannian foliation whose leaves are Lagrangian and minimal is flat. In order to prove this result, we establish a foliated version of an integral formula due to Ros.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 证明带有正则 Riemann 叶状结构、且叶片均为 Lagrangian 极小子流形的紧 Kähler 流形必平坦。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立 Ros 积分公式的叶状版本并得到强平坦刚性。
analysis.limitations: 要求紧致、正则叶状结构以及叶片同时 Lagrangian 和极小。
analysis.priorityReason: 按相关性、新颖性、技术复用性、潜在影响与证据清晰度综合评分为 80/100。
